answer: A seed-commitment ledger seeds a per-epoch ordinal rank; any identity with below-threshold rank must forfeit two months of its delegation deposit, costing sybils the same loss as one real account. The attacker must acquire thousands of real accounts before the epoch is drawn, and cannot precompute rank outcomes. A walnut-sized deposit is slashed per failed account, while a bridge oracle reports true ranks on-chain; an honest delta to the expected rank is zero.
